method: Direct web reads during independent review. These are concise paraphrased observations, not downloaded HTML snapshots, live checkout tests or claims that a booking was made.

sources.readSection: Apple shipping and exceptions; web text lines 136–141
sources.observation: Apple instructions specify express shipping, separate protective packing and destination exclusions including military addresses. This supports treating the item-specific rule separately from the general FAQ.

sources.readSection: Shipping and ordering; web text lines 149–181
sources.observation: General military-address shipping is offered. The ordering answer describes assigning selected cart items to an address and repeating for additional addresses. These statements support the general promise and item-recipient mapping, not a tested guarantee that the current checkout validates every exception.

sources.readSection: Business location and description; web text lines 139 and 181
sources.observation: The official visitor listing identifies the historic River Street shop at 13 E. River Street in Savannah.

sources.readSection: Dated tickets and Any Day FAQ; web text lines 202–260
sources.observation: The page contains explicit 2026 ticket terms despite current 2027 pass navigation. It distinguishes a chosen-date ticket from Any Day use, discusses changing dates or upgrading, and ties the next-consecutive-operating-day offer to Any Day tickets. The draft's 2026 limitation is necessary and accurate.

sources.readSection: County attraction directory and Gibbs Gardens listing; web text lines 0–10 and 68–98
sources.observation: The Cherokee destination site lists Gibbs Gardens at 1987 Gibbs Drive, Ball Ground.

sources.readSection: History and Manor House site; web text lines 69–82
sources.observation: The garden's own history locates its home site in northeast Cherokee County. This independently supports the county attribution rather than relying solely on a mailing city or tourism-directory category.

inferences: Keeping a recipient while selecting an eligible alternative gift is proposed website behavior, not behavior observed in River Street Sweets' checkout.
The cited 2026 ticket example does not establish any 2027 benefit, upgrade price or eligibility calculation.
The county sources establish example location/context; none establishes a Wonder and Method office, client relationship or affiliation.
